evaluator.name: Anchored In Student Response Feedback-Quality Evaluator
evaluator.description: Is the feedback clearly based on the student's specific response? (Key features generated from rubric text; concept paper did not list explicit key feature items.)

feedback_text.description: The teacher feedback on that response.

steps.description: Single-call LLM step that produces the binary EvaluatorOutput JSON.

parser.notes: Uses LangChain JsonOutputParser-style format_instructions injected into the system prompt.

output_schema.title: EvaluatorOutput
output_schema.description: Final evaluator output for the is_anchored_in_student_response dimension.

reasoning.description: Step-by-step reasoning before the final answer: assess the student response against the task goal, then judge whether the teacher feedback meets the criterion.

key_features.description: Per-key-feature assessment; each feature judged independently.

specific_reference_to_student_work.description: Feedback should clearly reference or build on the student's specific idea, wording, or use of evidence

met.description: 1 if this key feature is satisfied by the feedback, 0 otherwise.

justification.description: One or two sentences grounding the met/not-met decision in the specific student response and teacher feedback.

not_generic_or_template_based.description: Feedback should not be a stock phrase that could apply to any response

met.description: 1 if this key feature is satisfied by the feedback, 0 otherwise.

justification.description: One or two sentences grounding the met/not-met decision in the specific student response and teacher feedback.

engage_based_on_accurate_understanding.description: Engages with the student's actual response, rather than something the student did not actually say or attempt. Demonstrates accurate understanding of what the student wrote.

met.description: 1 if this key feature is satisfied by the feedback, 0 otherwise.

justification.description: One or two sentences grounding the met/not-met decision in the specific student response and teacher feedback.

proposed_adjustment.description: How the teacher feedback could be modified to meet the criterion. If it already meets the criterion, say so briefly.

anchored_in_student_response_score.description: Overall: 1 if the feedback meets the criterion, 0 otherwise.

tracing.notes: Runtime engines MUST expose these five trace fields per evaluation.
